audit.note: First audit — no baseline for trend comparison

escalations.title: vitest <=3.2.5 — Arbitrary file read / code execution via UI server
escalations.fix: npm update vitest to >=3.2.6 in Source/Frontend and portal/Frontend

escalations.title: protobufjs <=7.6.4 — Arbitrary code execution via malicious .proto parsing
escalations.fix: Upgrade @grpc/grpc-js and protobufjs to latest in platform/orchestrator

p1.title: GET /api/search not registered in app.ts — DependencyPicker broken at runtime
p1.impact: DependencyPicker typeahead hits 404. 5 tests self-annotated as failing. Feature completely non-functional.
p1.recommendation: Create Source/Backend/src/routes/search.ts with case-insensitive title+description filter, {data:[]} wrapper, exclude soft-deleted. Register as app.use('/api', searchRouter) in app.ts.

p1.title: vitest <=3.2.5 — Arbitrary file read / code execution via UI server
p1.exploit_scenario: Attacker accesses vitest UI server (default :51204) and reads arbitrary files or triggers code execution without authentication

p1.title: protobufjs <=7.6.4 — Arbitrary code execution via proto parsing
p1.exploit_scenario: Attacker supplies a crafted .proto file to the orchestrator's gRPC stack, triggering arbitrary code execution on the server
p1.fix: Upgrade @grpc/grpc-js and protobufjs to latest versions

p1.title: @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node <=0.76.0 — DoS via malformed metrics request
p1.exploit_scenario: Attacker sends malformed HTTP request to GET /metrics; Prometheus exporter crashes, taking down portal/Backend observability and potentially the process

p1.title: @opentelemetry/sdk-node <=0.218.0 — Same Prometheus crash vector as DA-003
p1.exploit_scenario: Same as DA-003 — co-located in portal/Backend, same Prometheus exporter crash path

p1.title: uuid <11.1.1 — Buffer bounds check missing in v3/v5/v6 UUID generation
p1.exploit_scenario: If caller supplies a buf parameter to uuid.v3/v5/v6, missing bounds check allows write outside buffer, risking memory/data corruption
p1.fix: npm update uuid to >=11.1.1 in Source/Backend

p2.title: dependencyCheckDuration Histogram missing from metrics.ts — FR-dependency-metrics gap
Traceability enforcer blind to FR-dependency-* — gate gives false confidence
brace-expansion <=1.1.17 — DoS via exponential expansion (3 CVEs)
browserslist <=4.28.6 — Unbounded memory growth + crash (2 CVEs)
js-yaml <=3.15.0 — Quadratic CPU consumption in merge-key chains (3 CVEs)

cross_reference_map.root_cause: OTel ecosystem not consistently managed across workspaces
cross_reference_map.single_fix: Add @opentelemetry/sdk-node + @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node to Source/Backend; simultaneously update OTel packages in portal/Backend to >=0.222.0
cross_reference_map.fix_impact: Closes 3 findings: adds missing tracing pillar (QO-004) + resolves 2 DoS CVEs (DA-003, DA-004)

cross_reference_map.root_cause: Frontend build tooling (vite/vitest) pinned to vulnerable versions in both Frontend workspaces
cross_reference_map.single_fix: Update vitest >=3.2.6 and vite >=6.4.3 in both Source/Frontend and portal/Frontend in a single PR
cross_reference_map.fix_impact: Closes 2 findings with one change, removes P1 escalation trigger

cross_reference_map.root_cause: Traceability enforcer gap allows FR-dependency-* to remain untested by gate
cross_reference_map.single_fix: Add FR-dependency-search and remaining FR-dependency-* IDs to Plans/self-judging-workflow/requirements.md; gate will then catch the missing search route automatically
cross_reference_map.fix_impact: Closes QO-003 and makes QO-001 automatically enforced going forward
